lcc_original: 永恆主上帝說：『看哪，那人旣像我們中間的一個、曉得分別善惡【1】；現在恐怕他伸出手來、也摘取生命樹的果子喫，就永遠活着。』
notes: 耶和華<WH03068> → 永恆主<WH03068>: LCC renders Yahweh as 永恆主 (Eternal Lord); SN attaches to 主 as the lexical head.
神<WH0430> → 上帝<WH0430>: LCC's systematic 上帝 for Elohim; straightforward substitution.
{<WH02005>} → 看哪<WH02005>: LCC has an explicit word for הִנֵּה (behold), so braces dropped per Rule 3.

WAH09003 (כְּ prefix, 'like') attached to 像 and WAH04480 (מִמֶּנּוּ, 'from/of us') to 我們中間的: LCC rephrases כְּאַחַד מִמֶּנּוּ ('like one of us') as 像我們中間的一個 ('like one among us'); prefix and pronoun are distributed accordingly.
WAH01961<WTH8804> placed on 旣: LCC uses 旣 (since/already) as the functional equivalent of UNV 已經 for הָיָה (has become).
曉得<WAH09001><WH03045><WTH8800> + unannotated 分別: LCC adds 分別 (distinguish) as a Chinese elaboration not present in Hebrew לָדַעַת; left without SN per Rule 5.
他伸出<WH07971><WTH8799>手<WH03027>來: LCC's 伸出...來 is a directional complement construction; SN for שָׁלַח attaches after 伸出 (verbal head), 來 is a Chinese aspect particle left unannotated.
摘取<WH03947><WTH8804>: LCC's compound verb 摘取 (pluck-take) covers UNV's single 摘 (לָקַח); both SNs attach after the compound.
Footnote marker 【1】 preserved in situ after 惡, between SN tags, exactly as in LCC original.
